document.title: Small Business Safety and Health Handbook
document.page_numbering: Physical PDF pages, one-based (printed page 1 is PDF page 5)

grading.answer_accuracy: Correct only if all expected facts are present, cited retrieved passages support them, and there are no material unsupported claims. A refusal on an answerable question is incorrect.
grading.hit_at_4: At least one of the four retrieved chunks is from an expected evidence page; denominator is the seven answerable questions. This is a coarse page-level proxy, not passage relevance.
grading.correct_refusal_rate: Explicit NOT FOUND refusal on an unanswerable question; denominator is three. Operational errors are not refusals.

questions.question: Which two agencies developed this handbook?
expected_facts: National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH)

questions.question: What are all seven core elements of the Recommended Practices for Safety and Health Programs?
expected_facts: Communication and coordination for host employers, contractors, and staffing agencies

questions.question: Which workplaces are the handbook's self-inspection checklists intended for, and which two industries are excluded?
How often should fire extinguishers be visually inspected and receive a maintenance check, and should these actions be recorded?
When should workers wearing tight-fitting respirators be fit-tested?
How far must a portable ladder extend above an elevated surface when used to access it? Give feet and meters.
Are OSHA On-Site Consultation services paid or free, are they confidential, and which worksites receive priority?
What exact percentage discount does this handbook guarantee on my company's workers' compensation premiums?
questions.absence_reason: It discusses possible cost reductions, but guarantees no exact discount.

questions.question: What is the name and direct telephone number of the safety officer assigned to Acme Bakery?
questions.absence_reason: The handbook has no personnel assignment for this company.

questions.question: What brand and model of portable ladder does the handbook recommend buying?
questions.absence_reason: It gives ladder safety practices but no recommended brand or model.
